content: {"summary":"Users report that playback stops unexpectedly and controls disappear, forcing app restarts to resume music.[#rv_3749779709334236975] The now‑playing bar and pause/skip buttons vanish during use, especially after updates, leaving no way to manage playback.[#rv_-5700067493002022049] This issue occurs in various contexts—workouts, driving, or while leaving the app—causing frustration and safety concerns.[#rv_-6984786771669701712] The problem persists across devices, requiring frequent app closures to restore functionality.[#rv_7445841060292801067]"}
